parameters.content:
## 00 Supabase Control Plane

Uses the native Supabase node for the operational data layer. Run the companion schema SQL once in Supabase, configure the Supabase credential, then execute this connectivity and table check.

## 01-07 Enterprise Lead Intake

Authenticated intake, idempotency, safe website evidence, native OpenAI Responses with strict JSON Schema, independent AI evaluation, explainable scoring, native HubSpot contact/deal orchestration, native Supabase persistence, Gmail draft and native Slack alert.

The only HTTP Request node retrieves an arbitrary public company website after URL safety checks; there is no service-specific n8n node for arbitrary website content.

## 08 Reply Intelligence

Classifies inbound responses, enforces opt-out and human-handoff rules, cancels unsafe scheduled actions and records the state transition.

## 09 Booking and Sales Handoff

Consumes booking events, cancels follow-ups, updates HubSpot, produces a discovery brief and alerts the assigned sales team.

## 10 Discovery Intelligence

Processes call transcripts, extracts evidence-grounded requirements, flags contradictions and determines proposal readiness before updating CRM and state.

## 11-13 Operations

Native Supabase job processing, Gmail draft controls, native Slack escalation, SLA breach detection, weekly revenue metrics and native OpenAI executive reporting.

## 98-99 Controlled Recovery

Dead-letter capture, sanitized incident context, retry classification, operator-authorized replay packaging and operational notifications.
